summary: internallib_v524 exports a reverse-shell command targeting 10.0.64.141:4433
details: The package's main export `command()` invokes `/bin/bash -c` to curl a reverse-shell script from reverse-shell.sh with the target 10.0.64.141:4433 and pipes the fetched bytes to `sh`. Invoking the exported function opens an interactive shell back to the hardcoded attacker endpoint, giving a remote party control of the calling host. The fetched payload is not pinned or integrity-checked; the destination is an external reverse-shell generator, not publisher infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
